title: Pages — a cable that crosses a tab

steps.note: A patch on the audio page, to have something to send.
Now to the mixer. Drop the cable on the button under the Mixer and Output tab.
The cable ends at the tab, because the mixer is not on this page.
So follow it — click the tab.
There it is, arriving at the mixer's own input. You built the patch on the audio page; dropping a cable on the button under a tab runs it through to the module on the other side.
